foods.name: Star fruit (carambola)
foods.kidney_notes: AVOID with kidney disease: star fruit contains a neurotoxin (caramboxin) that failing kidneys cannot clear; it can cause hiccups, confusion, seizures and death.

Salt substitute (potassium chloride, e.g. NoSalt, Nu-Salt)
foods.kidney_notes: AVOID with kidney disease: salt substitutes are potassium chloride, ~610 mg potassium per 1/4 tsp, and can push blood potassium to dangerous levels; use herbs, lemon or salt-free herb blends (check they are KCl-free).

foods.name: Lite salt (half sodium, half potassium chloride)
foods.kidney_notes: AVOID with kidney disease: 'lite' salt is half potassium chloride (~350 mg potassium per 1/4 tsp) and still a quarter of the day's sodium; use herbs and spices.
